agent-harness-performance.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run the agent-harness-performance job. Analyze VO agent run metrics from the past 7 days vs the 7 days before that. Data sources: (1) Audit logs at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/audit/2026-*.jsonl -- each line is JSON with timestamp, agent, job, action (started/completed/failed), details (exit_code, duration). Parse duration as seconds (remove 's' suffix). (2) Error log at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/state/errors.jsonl -- each line has agent, job, exitCode, summary, duration. (3) Hang incidents at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHangScout/*.jsonl and incidents/. (4) Loop detector at $TEMP/claude-loop-detector.jsonl (may not exist yet). Compute these metrics for current vs previous week: (a) Total runs and success rate (exit_code 0 vs non-zero), (b) Average run duration per agent, (c) Error count by agent, (d) Hang count, (e) Loop detection count. For each metric, compute the delta and mark as good/bad/neutral. Generate per-agent breakdown rows. For the duration chart, compute daily average duration across all agents. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/mAuditor-harness-performance.html. Read the template, replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Harness Monitor | Job: agent-harness-performance | Start: <PST> | Complete: <PST>. Replace {{BASELINE_DATE}} with 2026-04-14. Replace {{HARNESS_CHANGES}} with: Phase 0 (env vars: DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING, NO_FLICKER, showThinkingSummaries), Phase 1 (CLAUDE.md hard rules, VO agent output rules, behavioral rules in all 9 agents), Phase 5 (PreToolUse test-before-commit hook, PostToolUse loop-detector hook). Save to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHarnessMonitor/harness-performance-YYYYMMDD.html and harness-performance-latest.html. Open in Edge.
agent-harness-performance.description: Weekly harness improvement metrics: error rates, durations, hangs, loops vs previous week

failure-review.prompt:
IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run the failure-review job. Analyze the past 7 days of VO agent failures to identify recurring patterns and harness improvement candidates. Data sources: (1) Audit logs at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/audit/2026-*.jsonl -- look for action='failed' entries. (2) Error log at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/state/errors.jsonl -- all unresolved errors. (3) Hang incidents at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHangScout/incidents/. For each failure: extract the error summary, agent, job, and duration. Group failures by pattern (same error message template, same agent, same exit code). For each pattern that occurred 2+ times, generate a 'harness improvement candidate': what CLAUDE.md rule, skill, or hook would prevent this class of failure. Output format: HTML report with sections: (1) Failure Summary (total failures, unique patterns, most-failing agent), (2) Recurring Patterns table (pattern, count, agents affected, sample error, candidate fix type: rule/skill/hook), (3) One-Off Failures (happened once, low priority), (4) Recommended Harness Changes (prioritized list of specific changes to propose), (5) Cost Summary -- include a cost section in the report using the following steps: (a) Fetch cost data by calling GET http://localhost:3000/api/costs?days=7 and parsing the JSON response. If the endpoint is unreachable, fall back to parsing the audit JSONL files directly: for each completed run entry, extract costUSD, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheCreationTokens, cacheReadTokens, contextUsedPct, model, durationMs, numTurns fields. (b) Read the cost partial template from ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/partials/cost-summary-section.html. (c) Compute: COST_TOTAL (sum of all costUSD, formatted as $N.NN), COST_RUNS (total completed run entries), COST_AVG (COST_TOTAL / COST_RUNS, formatted as $N.NN), COST_TOKENS (sum of inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheCreationTokens + cacheReadTokens, formatted with commas). (d) Compute per-agent rows: group runs by agent, sum costUSD and tokens, compute avg cost per run. Format each as a with class cs-agent-name on the agent name cell. (e) Compute context budget alerts: find all runs where contextUsedPct >= 70. Emit
  • for 70-89% and
  • for >=90%. If none, emit

    No context budget alerts.

    instead of a list. (f) Compute anomaly alerts: for each agent compute average costUSD. Flag any run where costUSD > 2x the agent average. Emit
  • . If none, emit

    No cost anomalies detected.

    . (g) Set COST_PERIOD to the 7-day date range (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD). (h) Replace all {{COST_*}} placeholders in the partial and insert the rendered HTML into the report after section (4). Save to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHarnessMonitor/failure-review-YYYYMMDD.html and failure-review-latest.html. Open in Edge.
failure-review.description: Weekly failure pattern analysis and harness improvement candidates

resolve-bugs-cleanup.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run the resolve-bugs-cleanup job. CRITICAL: You MUST use ADO MCP tools for ALL ADO queries -- do NOT use bash, python -c, or az CLI for any ADO operations. Using bash/python/az for ADO queries causes zombie shell hangs (see GitHub issue #34). Use mcp__azure-devops-domoreexp__wit_query_work_items with WIQL to query Resolved bugs: SELECT [System.Id],[System.Title],[System.State],[System.AssignedTo],[System.ResolvedDate],[System.AreaPath] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject]='MSTeams' AND [System.WorkItemType]='Bug' AND [System.State]='Resolved' AND ([System.AssignedTo]='qitxu@microsoft.com' OR [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'MSTeams\Calling Meeting Devices (CMD)\Meetings'). For each bug returned, use mcp__azure-devops-domoreexp__wit_get_work_item to fetch linked PRs, recent comments, and resolve date. Validate each bug: resolved for at least 1 day, linked PRs are merged, no comments in last 3 days, not blocked. Close validated bugs automatically using mcp__azure-devops-domoreexp__wit_update_work_item to set System.State to Closed and add a comment: Auto-closed by Virtual Office Harness Monitor agent. If any bash command is absolutely necessary (e.g. reading a local file), use a timeout parameter of 30000ms maximum. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/mAuditor-resolve-bugs-cleanup.html. Read the template file, then replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values with actual data. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Harness Monitor | Job: resolve-bugs-cleanup | Start: <PST timestamp when job started> | Complete: <PST timestamp when report is generated>. Save report to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHarnessMonitor/resolve-bugs-cleanup-YYYYMMDD.html (MUST be inside output/pHarnessMonitor/, not the root output/ dir). Also save a copy to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/pHarnessMonitor/resolve-bugs-cleanup-latest.html.
resolve-bugs-cleanup.description: Auto-close stale Resolved bugs assigned to me or in my area paths
